title: sultane qurasa'n ka zahoor aaj hua hai
body:
sultane qurasa'n ka zahoor aaj hua hai
maiqanae mid'hat pe hujoome sho'ara hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo naqsh chamakta nazar aata hai qamar me
wo naqsh shahe toos ka naqshe kafe paa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
uqda koi dar pesh ho tum unko pukaaro
hamnaame ali misle ali uqda kusha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zikre raza noor wo taa hashr rahega
dunya me kahin noor bhi phooko'n se bujha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rouza hai shahedee'n ka bohot door watan se
is tarah laqab unka ghareebul ghoraba hai
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hai rad ek hazaar ek balaaye'n
wo ek laqab shaahe qurasaa'n ka raza hai
